messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER --> P1: kodex (enterprise:kodex) - EU dedicated pool eu-3 is returning elevated 5xx on /v1/generate. 40% error rate over 2m, traffic ~100rps. Paging oncall @Priya Patel :rotating_light:

Priya Patel: I'm oncall, acknowledging. Samir please take backend triage. Jordan, start prepping account comms for Kodex + showstopper contacts.

Samir Khan: looking. Initial look at triton-eu-3 router shows repeated 502s upstream to model worker group triton-worker-3. CPU spiking and OOM logs on a subset of workers. Spawning diag script now.

Samir Khan: diag output (snippet):
```
# tail /var/log/triton/error.log
2026-06-12T15:08:02Z worker-7 OOM failed alloc 268435456
2026-06-12T15:08:03Z worker-7 restarting
2026-06-12T15:08:10Z router upstream 502 worker-7
```

Priya Patel: ok plan: 1) drain problematic workers 2) roll restart worker pool with reduced batch size 3) route Kodex traffic to eu-2 fallback while we validate. Start with a canary restart. Samir proceed.

Samir Khan: starting drain on worker-7..9. Applying kernel flag to reduce per-request memory: `EXPORT TRITON_MAX_BATCH=8` on canary nodes.

Jordan Lee: Kodex contacts (for routing/notify):
- Primary: kodex-ops@kodex.com (ops-oncall)
- Secondary: alice.kodex@kodex.com, +1-415-555-0199
- CSM: Linh.Tran@redwood.com (copied)

Linh Tran: Jordan please include tailored impact blurb. Kodex uses inference for real-time underwriting — major customers may see delays or failures resulting in degraded decisioning. They need a short customer-facing line and an internal account playbook.

Evan Brooks: Drafting status page + customer email snippets. Posting drafts here for quick approval.

Evan Brooks: STATUS PAGE (external):
"Our team is investigating increased error rates affecting inference requests for customers on EU dedicated pool eu-3. You may experience failed requests or delayed responses. We are routing affected traffic to a fallback pool and expect intermittent errors to subside within 30 minutes. Updates will follow here."

Evan Brooks: CUSTOMER EMAIL (kodex-specific):
"Hi Kodex team — we detected elevated failures for inference requests from your dedicated EU pool (eu-3). Our engineers are rolling mitigations and routing traffic to a fallback pool. You may see brief request failures or higher latency. We do not believe data was at risk. ETA for stable service: ~30-45 minutes. We'll send another update once traffic is fully routed and errors are below 1%. — Priya, Redwood Inference"

Priya Patel: LGTM for external copy. Add 'no data exfil' sentence and keep it high-level. Jordan, please route to primary ops email and CSM.

Jordan Lee: Sending out to kodex-ops now. Using this subject: "[Redwood] Incident: Elevated errors for Kodex EU inference pool (eu-3)". Copying CSM.

Nora Chen: Paging escalation note: if error rate stays >20% after 15m, escalate to Platform Lead (Samira) and open a Priority hotline with Kodex (phone).

Samir Khan: canary pool restart applied, batch-size flag in place, memory pressure down on canary nodes. Error rate on canary <1%. Starting progressive rollout across remaining workers.

Priya Patel: route policy applied: kodex routes to eu-2 fallback (read-only routing shim) while we finish restarts. Routing change made at 15:27 UTC.

IncidentBot: Route change event recorded: route-policy:kodex -> eu-2-fallback by priya.p at 3166666720

Evan Brooks: Updated external status page with the copy above, marked "Identified" and added ETA 45m.

Jordan Lee: Confirmed notify email delivered to kodex-ops and alice.kodex. Reply from alice: "Thanks, we see increased 502s on our side too. We'll standby."

Mateo Ruiz: joining takeover for next 30m. Priya handing over active oncall at 15:40 UTC. All notes in channel.

Priya Patel: Handoff to Mateo: current status — routing to eu-2 fallback, progressive restarts in progress, error rate overall 12% down from 40%, kodex notified. If >20% after 15m escalate per Nora.

Mateo Ruiz: acknowledged, watching metrics. If rollback needed, we have runbook step: `kubectl scale deployment triton-worker --replicas=0 && kubectl apply -f worker-known-good.yaml` (use triage-helper script).

Samir Khan: rollout completed at 15:55 UTC. Post-roll metrics: error rate 0.8% for kodex traffic, CPU and memory stable.

Priya Patel: mitigation verified. Preparing final status page update and customer follow-up.

Evan Brooks: STATUS PAGE (update):
"Mitigated: Traffic for affected customers has been routed and worker pool restarted. Error rates have returned to normal. Incident has been resolved. If you continue to see issues, contact support."

Evan Brooks: CUSTOMER FOLLOW-UP (kodex):
"Update: The issue impacting inference requests has been mitigated. We completed a rolling restart of worker nodes and routed traffic to a fallback pool during remediation. Error rates have returned to normal. If you see anything else, reply to this thread or contact your CSM."

Jordan Lee: Sent follow-up to kodex-ops and logged the outreach in the account playbook.

Priya Patel: Closingpager. IncidentBot please open a postmortem draft and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml.

IncidentBot: Postmortem task created: PM-3166666666 in /incidents/postmortems assigned to Priya Patel, reviewers eng-runtime, eng-ml. :white_check_mark:

Nora Chen: quick note for postmortem: include root cause: worker OOM on model X under specific batch size + memory leak suspicion. Also include recommended mitigations: limit batch size per model, add OOM alerts, add automatic fallback earlier in routing policy.

Priya Patel: thanks team. Great coordination. :clap:
